user.title: Discovery Service
user.description: Enter the address of the Area Events Discovery Service and its tokens. The read token lets Home Assistant show events; the optional control token also lets administrators change shared discovery settings. {transport_note}

data_description.url: For example https://events.example:8780 (a TLS reverse proxy in front of the service) or http://localhost:8780 on the same computer.
data_description.read_token: Created by the service for read-only clients.
data_description.control_token: Leave empty to keep Home Assistant read-only. The token is stored only in Home Assistant's backend and is never sent to a dashboard.

reauth_confirm.title: Tokens rejected
reauth_confirm.description: The Discovery Service rejected a token. Enter the current tokens.

error.cannot_connect: The Discovery Service could not be reached. Check that it is running and that the address is correct.
error.invalid_auth: The Discovery Service rejected the read token.
error.invalid_control_token: The Discovery Service does not allow that token to change settings.

abort.already_configured: This Discovery Service is already set up.

data.scan_interval: Seconds between checks for new events

data_description.scan_interval: One check serves every card. Between 5 and 300 seconds.
